s: Dine habberakot leyeter hammaakalim, ubo y"ch seipim: al dabar sheen giddulo min haaretz, kegon besar behema chayya vaop, dagim vachagabim, chalab ugebina ubetzim, mayim, melach udebash — mebarekim "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veken kemehim upitriyyot, ap sheggiddulam min haaretz, shemmillachluchit haaretz hem gedelim al haetzim veal hakkelim, kevan sheen yeniqatam min haaretz ella min haavir — enam niqraim "peri haadama", umebarekin alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro":

Veken kol dabar shennishtanna leqilqul — nishtanna birkato hammeyuchedet lo, umebarekim alayv beraka hakkolelet hakkol, shehi "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", kegon happat sheippesha, vetabshil shennishtanna tzurato venitqalqel meat. Abal im nitqalqel legamre ad sheeno rauy laakila apillu al yede haddechaq — en mebarekin alayv kelal. Veken pat sheippesha. Veken yayin shehechmitz ad shebbene adam nimnaim lishtoto mippene chamitzuto — mebarekin alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veim naasa chometz gamur, dehaynu shehu chazaq kol kak shekkeshemmashlikim oto al haaretz hu mebabea umaaleh retichut — en mebarekin alayv kelal, mippene shehu mazziqo, veeno rauy lishtiyya kelal. Veim erebo bemayim ad shehu rauy lishtot — mebarek alayv "shehakkol":

Veken kol dabar sheen noteim oto al daat leoklo bederek shehu okelo — mebarek alayv "shehakkol", kegon perot chayyim shedderek akilatam sheal daat ken noteim otam hu leoklam mebushshalim. Veen tzarik lomar dabar sheen noteim oto al daat leoklo kelal, kegon haqqor shel deqel velulebe gepanim usheqedim harakkim, sheiqqar akilatam hi qelippatam hachitzona, veen notein otan al daat ken kelal. Mah sheen ken bishar perot shello nigmar bishshulam, kemo shennitbaer kol zeh besiman r"b:

Veken shachat shel tebua sheggozezin otah beodah yaraq veokelah — mebarekin aleha "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veken mine zeraim sheenam omedim laakila ella litten taam biqdera, kegon shebet vekammon vekusbar, ap al pi shehem metuqim vetobim laakila — mebarekin alehem "shehakkol". Veken kol mine perot shebbishshelam bemayim veasa mehem mashqeh, kegon shekar teenim veshekar temarim — mebarekin alehem "shehakkol". Vaapillu shekar seorim mebarekin alayv "shehakkol" velo "bore mine mezonot", hoil vehu tzalul veomed lishtiyya, veen mebarekin "bore mine mezonot" ella al maakal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch. Veeno domeh lemaraq shel tabshil mechameshet hamminin shemmebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot", lepi shehammaraq batel al gabbe hattabshil shehu omed beeno, mah sheen ken beshekar sheen bo kelum [mi]mammashut hasseorim. Veod shehammaraq iqqaro letzorek bishshul hattabshil, mah sheen ken beshekar, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"b:

Yesh omerim sheal issebe hassadeh sheenan nizraim — mebarekim "shehakkol". Bammeh debarim amurim? Baasabim shehem geruim mitztzad atzman, abal perot tobim haggedelim belo zeria, kegon otam sheqqorin yagyda"s malyn"sh — mebarekin "bore peri haadama", kemo shemmebarekin "bore peri haetz" al perot chashubim haggedelim beilane seraq, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"g. Veyesh mi shehaya noheg lebarek "bore peri haadama" al haggedelim baaretz u"bore peri haetz" al haggedelim bailan, apillu hem minim geruim kaasabim vedomehem:
Yayin sherecho chometz vetaamo yayin — adayin shem yayin alayv, velo nishtannet birkato. Abal im taamo chometz ap al pi sherecho yayin — mebarekin alayv "shehakkol", shehakkol holek achar hattaam:

Yayin mebushshal lo nishtanna ligriuta, ap al pi sheen kol adam shoteh yayin mebushshal kechay mippene chozqo, mikkol maqom, taamo verecho hem meshubbachim yoter, ulepikak lo nishtannet birkato, umebarekin alayv "bore peri haggapen":

Veken yayin shemmeorabim bo debash upilpelin, ap al pi shennishtanna taam hayyayin al yede haddebash vehappilpelin — lo nishtanna ligriuta, umebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen". Abal yayin shennitareb bo echad mishshear mashqin, im nitareb bo kol kak ad shennipsad taam hayyayin — en lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" ella "shehakkol", kevan shennishtanna ligriuta. Veim nitareb bo shekar teenim shehu eno mapsid taam hayyayin — holekim achar harob, im harob yayin — mebarekim "bore peri haggapen", veim harob shekar — mebarekim "shehakkol":

Yayin shemmezago bemayim, apillu hammayim hem harob — mebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", im hu yayin chazaq sherauy lishtiyya al yede meziga gedola kazo, vederek bene adam lishtoto bimqom yayin al yede meziga zo, sheim lo ken betela dato etzel kol adam. Veim hayyayin hu echad mishshishsha bammayim, sheyyesh bammayim shesh peamim kemoto — en mebarekin alayv "bore peri haggapen" bekol inyan, sheap al pi sheyyesh bo taam yayin — eno chashub kelum beshishsha chalaqim mayim:

Shimre yayin shebbemishmeret shennatan alehem mayim g' middot veyatza mehem d', shennitmatztza letokam midda achat yayin mehashshemarim — hare zeh keyayin mazug, shekken haya derek mezigat hayyayin bime chakme hattalmud, shehayu yenotehem chazaqim, lemozgo beg' chalaqim mayim, ulepikak mebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen". Veim yatza pachot mid', ap al pi sheyyesh bahem taam yayin — qiyyuha beolma hu, veen mebarekin alayv ella "shehakkol". Veyenot shellanu sheenam chazaqim kol kak — meshaarim beshiur mezigat hayyayin shebbeoto maqom, veim yatza pachot mizzeh mebarek "shehakkol". Abal shemarim shello natan alehem mayim — (en hayyotze mehem nechshab keqiyyuha beolma), ella yayin gamur hu, umebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen":

Temed sheosin mechartzannim o zaggim shennotenim alehem mayim — dinam kishmarim, sheim lo yatza mehem yayin keshiur meziga shebbeoto maqom — mebarekim alayv "shehakkol". Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechartzannim vezaggim shenneetzru beqora, abal im lo nidreku ella baregel, kevan shennishar bahem lachluchit yayin harbeh, apillu natan alehem g' middot umatza g' o pachot — mebarekim alayv "bore peri haggapen", sheyyayin hu, vehammayim niblaim bazzaggim ubachartzannim, ubemah sheyyotze yesh bo yayin merubbeh. Vetzimmuqim shennatan alehem mayim — yitbaer besiman ar"b:

Zaggin shennatenu alehem teenim lechazzeq koach hayyayin, ap al pi shehazzaggin hem (merubbeh) [harob] — yesh lehistappeq im rauy lebarek al temed hazzeh "bore peri haggapen", kevan shekkol koach hatteenim bammashqeh. Umissapeq yebarek "shehakkol" kebirkat me sheriyyat teenim ushear perot, shemmebarekin alehem "shehakkol" ledibre hakkol, im hem omedim lishtiyya, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"b. Veim shata keshiur shechayyab beraka acharona verotzeh latzet yede sapeq — yishteh yayin vibarek acharayv, veyippater millebarek achar temed zeh mimmah napshak, shehayyayin poter kol mine mashqeh, ben mibberaka rishona ben mibberaka acharona, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"ch vesiman qa"d:

En mebarekin al hammayim "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" battechilla u"bore nepashot rabbot" baacharona ella kesheshshoteh litzmao. Abal im shoteh lehablia lugmato shechanaqto — eno mebarek lo battechilla velo bassop, lepi sheen hanaa laadam bishtiyyat hammayim ella beshaa shehu tzame. Abal shear mashqin sheyyesh hanaa laggup bishtiyyatan ubetaaman — tzarik lebarek alehem battechilla ubassop, ap al pi sheeno taeb lahem, veeno shoteh beratzon ella mechamat ones lugmato shechanaqto, kevan shemmikkol maqom hu nehena bishtiyyatam:

Veken kol hookalim vehammashqim sheadam okel veshoteh lirpua, im taaman tob vehachek nehena mehem — mebarek alehem techilla vasop, ap al pi sheeno taeb lahem kelal, veeno okelam ella mechamat ones cholyo. Abal im hem raim sheen lo hanaa, ap al pi shemmitrappe mehem — eno mebarek lo battechilla velo bassop. (Veim enam tobim velo raim legamre — yesh mi sheomer shelleolam mebarek alehem "shehakkol"):

Veken choleh haokel beyom hakkippurim, o mi sheokel debar issur mippene hassakkana, kevan shennehena tzarik lebarek battechilla ubassop, ap al pi sheeno nehena beratzon kelal, ella mechamat ones cholyo. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin lebari sheanasuhu listim leekol velishtot, sheap al pi shennehena mechamat ones — tzarik lebarek. Ella im ken napsho qatza milleekol, beinyan sheen zo hanaa kelal, al derek shennitbaer besiman qtz"z. Veyesh omerim shehabbari sheanasuhu listim — eno mebarek al akilato ushetiyyato, ap al pi shei epshar shello yehaneh, ki ek yebarek Hashem shebbara maakal zeh o mashqeh zeh veen lo chepetz bo kelal akshav, mah sheen ken becholeh, shekkevan shekkebar hu choleh, vechapetz lehitrappeot bemaakal o bemashqeh zeh — kol shekken shechayyab lehodot laHashem shebberaam. Veap shemmishshum hanaat repua lebaddah en lo lebarek birkat hannehenin, mikkol maqom, tzarik lebarek mishshum haakila vehashshetiyya shehu chapetz bahem kede lehitrappeot, kevan shekkebar hu choleh. Abal beones listim, ap shekkebar bau alayv listim — illu lo nibra maakal lo hayu onesim oto leoklo (usepeq berakot lehaqel):

Debash shebbishshelo im mine besamim ketushim kede lebassemo keminhag holeke derakim — haddebash iqqar vehabbesamim tepelim, umebarek "shehakkol", shehare habbesamim baim letaqqen haddebash ulehatimo. Abal mine mirqachat mipperot o asabim o mine besamim meruqqachim bidbash, apillu hem ketushim beyoter umeorabim bidbash — hem chashubim iqqar, umebarekim alehem birkatam, al derek shennitbaer besiman r"b, lepi shehaddebash hu ba leqayyem dabar hamruqqach bo, lepikak hu tapel etzlo apillu hu harbeh mimmennu:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemirqachat (shehi asuya leqiyyum, leekol mimmenna meat meat lipraqim, velo leoklah harbeh lemazon uletabshil, lepikak en haddebash nechshab iqqar ap al pi shehu harob). Abal tabshil heasuy laakila hannaasa mittaarobet debash uminim acherim sheenam mechameshet mine dagan ella kegon perot veqitniyyot — holekim achar harob, veim harob hu debash — hu iqqar, umebarek alayv upoter et happerot, veken behepek, apillu enam ketushim umeorabim immo, ella omedim beenam betoko, kevan shennitbashshelu yachad venaasu tabshil echad. Vehu haddin lishar mashqim, chutz mimmayim. Abal im lo nitbashshelu yachad veereban leoklan yachad — en holekim achar harob, ella tzarik lebarek al shenehem, kemo shennitbaer besiman r"b, ella im ken echad mehem iqqar etzlo vehashsheni eno ella letaqqen ulehakshir akilat chabero, sheaz gam benitbashshelu yachad mebarek al haiqqar ap im hu hammuat:

"Shehakkol nihya bidbaro" tzarik lomar: "nihya" beqama"tz hayyu"d, shekkol habberakot nitqenu bilshon abar, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z. Velaken omerim "bore" velo "habbore", mippene she"bore" hu yoter meborar al heabar, kemo shennitbaer sham:
